description: ShanghaiRanking Global Ranking of Academic Subjects (GRAS): for a subject (55, e.g. Mathematics, Computer Science, Clinical Medicine, Economics) and year, ranked universities with rank or band, total score, the five indicator scores, country and institution URL. Filter by country or university name. Without a subject, lists the subjects and their codes. Usually answers in about 8 s, up to 18 s on slower calls; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: education_shanghai_arwu_rankings when you need ShanghaiRanking ARWU 2026 world university ranking: world; education_university_rankings_mega_pack when you need university rankings side by side from ShanghaiRanking ARWU. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Optional country/region as ShanghaiRanking writes it, e.g. United States, China, Türkiye

subject.description: Subject name or code, e.g. Mathematics or AS0101 (omit to list subjects)

university.description: Optional part of a university name

year.description: Ranking year, 2017 to 2026 (default: newest for the subject)
